region.name: Blood Moor & Den of Evil
region.details:
BLOOD MOOR & DEN OF EVIL
POINTS OF INTEREST Find the Den entrance in the Blood Moor outside the Rogue Encampment.
QUESTS Den of Evil: clear every monster inside, then speak to Akara for a skill point.
FARMING TIPS A useful early place to gain experience and find basic equipment. Use the remaining-monsters counter to find stragglers.
ROUTE Rogue Encampment → Blood Moor → Den of Evil. Look for the cave entrance outdoors; the Den has no waypoint.
REWARD Akara grants one skill point and one free respecialization per difficulty after the quest. Save the respec until you need it.
WATCH FOR Fallen shamans can revive Fallen, so clear the shamans and check dead ends before leaving.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Cold Plains & Burial Grounds
region.details:
COLD PLAINS & BURIAL GROUNDS
POINTS OF INTEREST The Cold Plains waypoint leads toward the Burial Grounds and its crypts.
QUESTS Sisters' Burial Grounds: defeat Blood Raven and return to Kashya for a Rogue mercenary.
FARMING TIPS Visit the Burial Grounds and nearby crypts for monsters and early gear; choose a difficulty your build can clear safely.
ROUTE Take the Cold Plains waypoint and explore the area for the Burial Grounds entrance. The Crypt and Mausoleum are optional side areas beside the cemetery.
REWARD After Blood Raven dies, speak to Kashya for a Rogue mercenary. A new hire replaces your current mercenary.
HELL FARM The Mausoleum is a familiar undead-heavy Hell farming stop; check monster immunities and prioritize safety over clearing speed.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Stony Field & Dark Wood
region.details:
STONY FIELD & DARK WOOD
POINTS OF INTEREST Find the Cairn Stones in the Stony Field and the Tree of Inifuss in the Dark Wood, through the Underground Passage.
QUESTS The Search for Cain: bring the scroll to Akara, activate the stones in the indicated order, and rescue Cain in Tristram.
FARMING TIPS Tristram contains groups of monsters and unique enemies. Revisit it for early experience and items.
ROUTE Stony Field → Underground Passage → Dark Wood. The passage has two levels; use level 1 to reach the Dark Wood. Return to Stony Field with Akara's translated scroll.
REWARD Rescuing Cain gives you a convenient identification service. Click his cage in Tristram and speak to him and Akara in town.
OPTIONAL Underground Passage level 2 became a level 85 area on Hell in patch 2.4.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Black Marsh & Forgotten Tower
region.details:
BLACK MARSH & FORGOTTEN TOWER
POINTS OF INTEREST Find the Forgotten Tower in the Black Marsh; the Countess is on the fifth cellar level.
QUESTS The Forgotten Tower: explore the tower and defeat the Countess.
FARMING TIPS The Countess is a popular repeat target for runes. Her possible drops change with difficulty; use the Black Marsh waypoint to start a run.
ROUTE Use the Black Marsh waypoint, find the tower and descend five cellar levels. The Countess is on the last level.
TARGETS Repeat Countess runs for early runeword ingredients. On Hell she may also drop a Key of Terror. Her special rune table and ordinary monster drops have different limits; do not assume a particular rune is guaranteed.
CAUTION Tower packs can be dangerous in tight corridors, and resistances or immunities change with difficulty.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Monastery & Catacombs
region.details:
MONASTERY & CATACOMBS
POINTS OF INTEREST Look for the Barracks, Jail, Inner Cloister and Catacombs; Andariel waits on Catacombs level 4.
QUESTS Tools of the Trade: recover the Horadric Malus in the Barracks. Sisters to the Slaughter: defeat Andariel.
FARMING TIPS Andariel is a repeatable act boss for item farming. Poison resistance and antidotes help against her attacks.
ROUTE Outer Cloister → Barracks → Jail → Inner Cloister → Cathedral → Catacombs. Take the Catacombs level 2 waypoint for repeat Andariel runs.
REWARDS Return the Malus to Charsi for one imbue. Defeat Andariel, then speak to Warriv to travel east. Check an item carefully before using the imbue reward.
PREPARATION Stock antidote potions, clear nearby packs, and leave room to move around Andariel.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Lut Gholein Sewers
region.details:
LUT GHOLEIN SEWERS
POINTS OF INTEREST The sewers beneath Lut Gholein contain Radament on level 3.
QUESTS Radament's Lair: defeat Radament and use the Book of Skill; find the Horadric Scroll nearby.
FARMING TIPS Clear the area for experience while pursuing the quest. Poison resistance can help against undead attacks.
ROUTE Enter the sewers from Lut Gholein. Take the level 2 waypoint and find Radament on level 3.
REWARD Use the Book of Skill to gain a skill point. Pick up the Horadric Scroll from the nearby chest and bring it to Cain to begin the staff investigation.
WATCH FOR Radament can revive nearby undead; try to clear space and avoid fighting an entire room at once.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Halls, Maggot Lair & Viper Temple
region.details:
HALLS, MAGGOT LAIR & VIPER TEMPLE
POINTS OF INTEREST The Halls of the Dead contain the Horadric Cube; the Maggot Lair holds the staff, and the Claw Viper Temple holds the amulet.
QUESTS The Horadric Staff and Tainted Sun: collect the pieces, transmute the staff and destroy the altar.
FARMING TIPS Keep the Cube for recipes. Narrow tunnels can be awkward for summons; reposition carefully and progress patiently.
ROUTE Dry Hills → Halls of the Dead level 3 for the Cube. Far Oasis → Maggot Lair level 3 for the Staff of Kings. Lost City → Valley of Snakes → Claw Viper Temple level 2 for the amulet.
NEXT STEP Put the staff and amulet in the Cube and transmute them. Keep the finished Horadric Staff for the true tomb. The Halls level 2 has a waypoint; the Maggot Lair and Viper Temple do not.
WARLOCK TIP Narrow Maggot Lair corridors can block your demon's path. Pull monsters into wider rooms where possible.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Arcane Sanctuary & Tombs
region.details:
ARCANE SANCTUARY & TOMBS
POINTS OF INTEREST The Palace leads to the Arcane Sanctuary. The Summoner's journal reveals the true tomb symbol.
QUESTS The Summoner and The Seven Tombs: defeat the Summoner, identify the tomb and use the completed staff to reach Duriel.
FARMING TIPS The Summoner and Duriel can be revisited. Prepare for Duriel's cold aura and close-quarters fight.
ROUTE Palace Cellar → Arcane Sanctuary. Search its four branches for the Summoner and read the journal. The red portal takes you to the Canyon of the Magi; activate its waypoint.
QUEST The journal reveals the true tomb symbol. Find the matching entrance, use the staff in the Orifice, defeat Duriel, and speak to the person beyond him before returning to town.
FARM On Hell the Summoner may drop a Key of Hate. Duriel is dangerous at close range; thawing potions and cold resistance can help.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Spider Forest & Flayer Jungle
region.details:
SPIDER FOREST & FLAYER JUNGLE
POINTS OF INTEREST The Spider Cavern holds Khalim's Eye; the Flayer Dungeon holds his Brain. The Gidbinn is in the Flayer Jungle.
QUESTS Khalim's Will: collect the relics. Blade of the Old Religion: recover the Gidbinn and return it to Ormus.
FARMING TIPS Dense groups can reward area damage, but small fast enemies can overwhelm fragile characters.
ROUTE Collect Khalim's Eye from Spider Cavern in Spider Forest and his Brain from Flayer Dungeon level 3 in Flayer Jungle. Spider Cavern and Arachnid Lair are different entrances.
SIDE QUEST Find the Gidbinn in Flayer Jungle, defeat the guardian, then return the blade to Ormus and speak with Asheara.
FARM Blizzard raised Arachnid Lair and all three Swampy Pit levels to area level 85 on Hell in patch 2.4. Check for dangerous monster combinations.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Kurast Bazaar & Sewers
region.details:
KURAST BAZAAR & SEWERS
POINTS OF INTEREST The Ruined Temple contains Lam Esen's Tome; Khalim's Heart is in the Kurast Sewers.
QUESTS Lam Esen's Tome: return the book to Alkor for attribute points. Collect the Heart for Khalim's Will.
FARMING TIPS Explore the temples and sewers for monsters and chests. Pack space and a town portal make longer runs easier.
ROUTE Explore Kurast Bazaar for the Ruined Temple and Lam Esen's Tome. Find the Kurast Sewers entrance in the Kurast area and descend to Khalim's Heart.
REWARD Return Lam Esen's Tome to Alkor for five attribute points per difficulty. Keep the Heart for the Khalim's Will transmutation.
FARM The Ruined Temple and Kurast Sewers level 1 are level 85 on Hell under Blizzard's patch 2.4 area changes.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Travincal & Durance of Hate
region.details:
TRAVINCAL & DURANCE OF HATE
POINTS OF INTEREST The High Council guards Travincal. After opening the way, the Durance leads to Mephisto on level 3.
QUESTS The Blackened Temple: defeat the Council. Khalim's Will opens the Durance. The Guardian: defeat Mephisto.
FARMING TIPS The Council and Mephisto are popular repeat targets for loot. Bring fire resistance for the Council and watch for dangerous Durance monsters.
ROUTE Collect Khalim's Eye, Brain, Heart and Flail, then transmute them in the Cube. Equip Khalim's Will and smash the Compelling Orb in Travincal. Take the Durance level 2 waypoint.
QUEST Defeat the Council and Mephisto; enter the red portal beyond Mephisto to reach Act IV. D2R patch 2.4 made completing Khalim's Will a proper Act III requirement.
FARM Council runs can yield gold and items; Mephisto is a boss target for gear. Watch Council Hydras and dangerous Durance packs.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Plains of Despair
region.details:
PLAINS OF DESPAIR
POINTS OF INTEREST Search the Plains of Despair for Izual.
QUESTS The Fallen Angel: defeat Izual and speak to Tyrael for two skill points.
FARMING TIPS The open area has many monsters, but its layout and enemy groups vary. Finish the reward on each difficulty.
ROUTE Pandemonium Fortress → Outer Steppes → Plains of Despair. Search the Plains for Izual; there is no waypoint in the Plains.
REWARD After the fight, speak to the released spirit and then Tyrael for two skill points. Repeat this on each difficulty.
PREPARATION Expect a long fight if your damage is low; leave room to retreat from surrounding packs.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: River of Flame & Hellforge
region.details:
RIVER OF FLAME & HELLFORGE
POINTS OF INTEREST The Hellforge and Hephasto are in the River of Flame; the river also leads toward the Chaos Sanctuary.
QUESTS The Hellforge: use the Hellforge Hammer to destroy Mephisto's Soulstone.
FARMING TIPS The Hellforge quest awards gems and a rune in the expansion; the rune range depends on difficulty. This is a quest reward, not a repeatable drop per character and difficulty.
ROUTE City of the Damned → River of Flame. Activate the River waypoint before searching for Hephasto and the Hellforge.
QUEST REWARD Take Mephisto's Soulstone, defeat Hephasto, equip the Hellforge Hammer, place the stone on the forge and strike it. Expansion rune ranges: El–Amn in Normal, Sol–Um in Nightmare, Hel–Gul in Hell. The quest reward is once per character per difficulty.
WATCH FOR The river can contain dangerous mixed packs; do not rush into unexplored areas.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Chaos Sanctuary
region.details:
CHAOS SANCTUARY
POINTS OF INTEREST Five seals surround Diablo's sanctuary. Opening them releases dangerous seal guardians.
QUESTS Terror's End: open the seals and defeat Diablo.
FARMING TIPS A popular late-game run for experience and items. Expect mixed damage types and immunities on higher difficulties.
ROUTE Start at the River of Flame waypoint and follow the river to the sanctuary. Open all five seals and defeat the seal guardians to summon Diablo.
FARM Clear packs and seal bosses for experience and items; Diablo adds an act-boss kill at the end. Faster clear speed matters more than piling on magic find if your damage becomes too low.
PREPARATION Keep fire and lightning resistance high, and watch for curses and enemy immunities.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Bloody Foothills & Frigid Highlands
region.details:
BLOODY FOOTHILLS & FRIGID HIGHLANDS
POINTS OF INTEREST Shenk the Overseer is in the Bloody Foothills; imprisoned soldiers are in the Frigid Highlands.
QUESTS Siege on Harrogath: defeat Shenk and return to Larzuk. Rescue on Mount Arreat: free the soldiers for Qual-Kehk.
FARMING TIPS Shenk and nearby Eldritch are commonly visited from the Frigid Highlands waypoint for quick monster kills.
ROUTE Harrogath → Bloody Foothills → Frigid Highlands. Shenk is near the transition; the Frigid Highlands waypoint makes later runs shorter. Find and open all three soldier pens in the Highlands.
REWARDS Speak to Larzuk after Shenk for his socketing reward. Speak to Qual-Kehk after the rescue for Tal, Ral and Ort runes. Socket counts depend on the item; research the base first.
FARM Eldritch and Shenk can be combined into a quick repeat run, but do not stand under the falling projectiles after Shenk dies.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Frozen River & Halls of Vaught
region.details:
FROZEN RIVER & HALLS OF VAUGHT
POINTS OF INTEREST Anya is trapped in the Frozen River. Nihlathak is in the Halls of Vaught, reached through Anya's portal after her rescue.
QUESTS Prison of Ice: rescue Anya. Betrayal of Harrogath: defeat Nihlathak.
FARMING TIPS Nihlathak is a repeat target for keys in Hell difficulty. His corpse explosions can be deadly; keep distance and control corpses where possible.
ROUTE Crystalline Passage → Frozen River for Anya. Bring Malah's potion back to Anya, return to town and speak with Malah and Anya. Anya's red portal leads toward Nihlathak.
REWARDS Use Malah's Scroll of Resistance for +10 all resistances per difficulty. Anya also gives a class-specific item and offers personalization after Nihlathak.
FARM Hell Nihlathak may drop a Key of Destruction. His corpse explosions are a major danger. Activate waypoints deliberately; portal behavior depends on quest progression.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Arreat Summit & Worldstone Keep
region.details:
ARREAT SUMMIT & WORLDSTONE KEEP
POINTS OF INTEREST The Ancients guard Arreat Summit; the Worldstone Keep leads to the Throne of Destruction and Baal.
QUESTS Rite of Passage: defeat the Ancients. Eve of Destruction: defeat Baal. Ancients require level 20/40/60 in Normal/Nightmare/Hell for quest credit.
FARMING TIPS Baal and his waves are common experience and item targets. Prepare for varied monsters and resistances.
ROUTE Ancients' Way → Arreat Summit. After defeating the Ancients, enter the Worldstone Keep and look for the level 2 waypoint, then continue to the Throne of Destruction.
QUEST The Ancients require level 20 / 40 / 60 for quest credit on Normal / Nightmare / Hell. Defeat Baal's waves and enter the chamber to fight Baal.
FARM The waves and Baal are useful repeat targets for experienced characters. Enemy combinations can vary, so adapt to immunities and retreat when needed.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Tamoe Highland & The Pit
region.details:
TAMOE HIGHLAND & THE PIT
POINTS OF INTEREST The Pit is a two-level optional dungeon in the Tamoe Highland, reachable from the Outer Cloister side of the monastery.
QUESTS No main quest requires The Pit. Save the Outer Cloister waypoint for repeat trips.
FARMING TIPS A popular Hell item-farming area with many boss packs. Archers and mixed immunities can be dangerous; bring a second damage source or rely on your demon where appropriate.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Secret Cow Level
region.details:
SECRET COW LEVEL
POINTS OF INTEREST After completing the final act quest on the current difficulty, collect Wirt's Leg in Tristram and transmute it with a Tome of Town Portal in the Rogue Encampment.
QUESTS The portal leads to an optional area; it is separate from the main quest line. Use ingredients obtained for the current difficulty.
FARMING TIPS Dense packs make the area a popular target for experience, socketable bases and runes. Keep a retreat route and avoid surrounding your character.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Rocky Waste & Stony Tomb
region.details:
ROCKY WASTE & STONY TOMB
POINTS OF INTEREST Find the Stony Tomb in the Rocky Waste outside Lut Gholein. It has two levels and no waypoint.
QUESTS Optional side dungeon; it is not needed for the Horadric Staff.
FARMING TIPS Both Stony Tomb levels became area level 85 on Hell in patch 2.4. A useful alternative to repeatedly farming act bosses, provided your build can clear its monsters safely.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Lost City & Ancient Tunnels
region.details:
LOST CITY & ANCIENT TUNNELS
POINTS OF INTEREST The Ancient Tunnels entrance is in the Lost City; use the Lost City waypoint and look for a trapdoor.
QUESTS Optional side dungeon. The Lost City also connects toward the Valley of Snakes for the Tainted Sun quest.
FARMING TIPS A well-known Hell farming area for monster packs and chests. Check resistances on individual bosses rather than assuming every monster can be damaged by your main element.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Golden Bird & Kurast Docks
region.details:
GOLDEN BIRD & KURAST DOCKS
POINTS OF INTEREST The Jade Figurine can be found from a unique monster in Act III. Bring it to Meshif, then follow the town conversations to Alkor.
QUESTS The Golden Bird: trade the figurine for the Golden Bird, then receive and use Alkor's Potion of Life for a permanent life reward.
FARMING TIPS Complete this while progressing through the jungle; there is no need to stop for a dedicated farming run. The reward can be earned again on each difficulty.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Lower Kurast
region.details:
LOWER KURAST
POINTS OF INTEREST Use the Lower Kurast waypoint to reach its buildings, containers and surrounding monsters.
QUESTS There is no major quest objective in Lower Kurast itself. It lies on the route toward the Kurast Bazaar.
FARMING TIPS Players often check the chests and other containers in the huts. Results are random and affected by game conditions; clear or avoid enemies according to your build.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Nihlathak's Temple & Pindleskin
region.details:
NIHLATHAK'S TEMPLE & PINDLESKIN
POINTS OF INTEREST After rescuing Anya, her red portal leads to Nihlathak's Temple. Pindleskin and his pack guard the entrance to the Halls.
QUESTS The temple is on the route for Betrayal of Harrogath. Pindleskin is an optional target.
FARMING TIPS A short run while the red portal is available. His pack can charge suddenly, so summon your demon and prepare defenses before entering.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Act I: Safer experience & item route
region.details:
ACT I: SAFER EXPERIENCE & ITEM ROUTE
POINTS OF INTEREST Start from the Cold Plains waypoint. Clear the Burial Grounds and one open route toward the Stony Field; add the Forgotten Tower from the Black Marsh waypoint only when your character is comfortable there.
QUESTS Blood Raven is part of Sisters' Burial Grounds. The Tower is optional, so it can be skipped without slowing campaign progress.
FARMING TIPS BEST FOR: early experience, basic upgrades and a low-pressure return route. The Cold Plains is open enough to retreat, regroup your summons and avoid being surrounded. Use the Burial Grounds when you want more monsters, then leave once rare packs begin taking too long. For early runes, make the Countess an optional final stop rather than forcing the narrow Tower on every run. If archer, ghost or cursed packs begin to consume potions, reset the game or stay in the open fields instead of pressing through the stairs.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Act II: Safer experience & item route
region.details:
ACT II: SAFER EXPERIENCE & ITEM ROUTE
POINTS OF INTEREST Use the Rocky Waste exit outside Lut Gholein to find the Stony Tomb. Its two levels are a self-contained optional route; return to town through a portal rather than walking back through the desert.
QUESTS The Stony Tomb is optional and does not block the Horadric Staff quest, so it is easy to leave for later if the monster mix is uncomfortable.
FARMING TIPS BEST FOR: a focused dungeon clear with items and experience, especially once it can be completed without repeated retreats. It has more room to position a mercenary and your demon than the Maggot Lair, making it a friendlier choice for minion builds. Clear the entrance pack first, work outward from doorways, and skip dangerous unique packs instead of trying to prove the run. In Hell, Ancient Tunnels from the Lost City waypoint is a stronger item route once your resistances and damage are ready; it is not a requirement for a safe progression loop.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Act III: Safer experience & item route
region.details:
ACT III: SAFER EXPERIENCE & ITEM ROUTE
POINTS OF INTEREST For combat experience, start at the Flayer Jungle waypoint and clear a short exterior loop before returning. For a lower-combat item run, use the Lower Kurast waypoint and check nearby huts, chests and weapon or armor racks.
QUESTS Neither route requires a dedicated quest turn-in. Keep the Gidbinn and Khalim relic objectives separate from a farming run when you want a quick reset.
FARMING TIPS BEST FOR: choose Flayer Jungle for experience and Lower Kurast for quick item checks. Do not try to full-clear every jungle branch: fast small enemies and dense packs can turn a safe run into a potion drain. In Lower Kurast, take the containers close to the waypoint, town out when inventory fills, and leave hostile packs behind if the goal is loot rather than experience. These routes are safer when they remain short; a fast reset after a clean loop is better than forcing a bad map or a dangerous champion pack.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Act IV: Safer experience & item route
region.details:
ACT IV: SAFER EXPERIENCE & ITEM ROUTE
POINTS OF INTEREST Use the City of the Damned or River of Flame waypoint for a small, deliberate exterior loop. Add Izual or the Hellforge only when the relevant quest is still open; save the Chaos Sanctuary for a separate, prepared run.
QUESTS Izual grants skill points and the Hellforge is a one-time quest reward. Chaos Sanctuary finishes the act through Terror's End.
FARMING TIPS BEST FOR: controlled experience while progressing, rather than a truly low-risk farm. Act IV has fewer forgiving detours and its enemy damage can jump sharply, so treat open terrain as your safety tool: pull one group at a time, keep a town portal behind you, and do not chase monsters into corners. River of Flame and Chaos Sanctuary can be excellent item and experience content once your build handles their immunities and damage, but they are not the safer choice for an undergeared character. A clean short loop in the Plains of Despair or River is the better stopgap until your gear improves.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Act V: Safer experience & item route
region.details:
ACT V: SAFER EXPERIENCE & ITEM ROUTE
POINTS OF INTEREST Take the Frigid Highlands waypoint, defeat Eldritch near the waypoint, then travel toward Shenk in the Bloody Foothills if the first fight is comfortable. After rescuing Anya, Pindleskin is an optional short stop through her red portal.
QUESTS Eldritch is an optional target. Shenk completes Siege on Harrogath; rescuing Anya unlocks her portal and continues Prison of Ice.
FARMING TIPS BEST FOR: quick elite kills, experience and item chances with a short retreat path. Let your mercenary and demon engage first, especially when Eldritch's pack spawns with dangerous modifiers. Shenk is worth adding only when the Foothills approach remains quick; skip him when ranged attackers, exploding siege effects or a bad elite pack slow the route. Pindleskin is fast but begins at close range, so raise defenses and summon before entering. Worldstone Keep and Baal offer more experience later, but their varied monster groups make them a higher-risk route until your character is ready.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
Sources: classic.battle.net/diablo2exp/quests/ and /maps/; Blizzard D2R patch 2.4 notes.

region.name: Terror Zones
region.details:
TERROR ZONES
POINTS OF INTEREST Once Terror Zones are enabled for your game, the active region is announced in game and marked on the waypoint menu.
QUESTS Terror Zones are an optional endgame activity; availability depends on your difficulty and game progress.
FARMING TIPS A terrorized area's monster levels can increase with the player level, subject to difficulty caps. Check the current zone in game and choose one your build can clear safely; the guide does not predict the live rotation.
Maps vary between games; rewards and drops depend on difficulty and game mode.
